metadata.historical_extraction: Each tag is read from its own Git tree. Missing registries use uncertain package exports.
metadata.main_extraction: The main snapshot uses origin/main when available, otherwise the local main ref; the exact Git commit is recorded.
metadata.signature_extraction: Python AST; package modules are not imported.
metadata.working_tree_extraction: The working-tree target has no Git revision or branch identity; source_digest identifies its content.
